newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle steady $110.00/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle steady $110.00/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was fairly active, USDA said.
Live and dressed sales fully steady. Demand and seller interest usually good. Most showlists now well depleted. A goodly number of the week's sold numbers will be slaughtered this week.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs - mostly 68.00; dressed basis mostly 110.00. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1225 lbs - 68.00-68.50; dressed basis mostly 110.00.

For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live and dressed basis steady. Weekly total includes 6,200 formulated and previously contracted cattle. Confirmed - 15,000 Last Week - 9,300 Last Year - 23,600
For week - 79,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 80,500 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 83,000
